page: Microsoft Azure NC72lds_xl_RTXPRO6000BSE_v6 is a GPU-accelerated virtual machine belonging to the NCdsRTXPRO6000BSEv6XL family. It is powered by an Intel processor with an x86_64 architecture, delivering 72 dedicated vCPUs. The instance is managed via the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features a low-memory configuration relative to its compute capacity, providing 132.0 GB of system memory, which equates to approximately 1.83 GB of RAM per core.

For storage-heavy workloads, the server is equipped with 3960 GB of local NVMe SSD storage. Additionally, it is premium storage capable, allowing for high-performance external disk attachments. The hardware configuration includes a single GPU to accelerate parallel computing tasks. Network connectivity does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

This hardware profile represents a specific tradeoff, offering high compute density and local NVMe storage capacity alongside dedicated GPU acceleration, but with a constrained memory-to-vCPU ratio. This makes the server highly cost-efficient for workloads that require massive parallel processing and fast local storage but do not demand large system memory footprints. Suitable workloads include GPU-accelerated compute tasks, rendering, machine learning inference, and localized database operations.
